paper_title: SciLaD: A Large-Scale, Transparent, Reproducible Dataset for Natural Scientific Language Processing
reason: SciLaD는 과학 논문 코퍼스(사전학습용 데이터셋)와 이를 이용한 RoBERTa 모델 논문이다. 평가에 쓴 NER, PICO, REL, CLS, DEP 벤치마크는 SciBERT 논문의 기존 벤치마크(BC5CDR, SciERC 등)를 그대로 따른 것이며, 새로 만든 평가 벤치마크가 아니다. 저자들이 공개하는 평가 파이프라인(scilons-eval)은 기존 벤치마크를 미세조정하고 평가하는 하니스일 뿐이고, 새로운 과제나 데이터를 추가하지 않는다. 따라서 재사용 가능한 LLM 벤치마크를 새로 도입하거나 실질적으로 갱신한 논문으로 보기 어렵다.

screening.paper_title: SciLaD: A Large-Scale, Transparent, Reproducible Dataset for Natural Scientific Language Processing
screening.abstract: SciLaD is a novel, large-scale dataset of scientific language constructed entirely using open-source frameworks and publicly available data sources. It comprises a curated English split containing over 10 million scientific publications and a multilingual, unfiltered TEI XML split including more than 35 million publications. We also publish the extensible pipeline for generating SciLaD. The dataset construction and processing workflow demonstrates how open-source tools can enable large-scale, scientific data curation while maintaining high data quality. Finally, we pre-train a RoBERTa model on our dataset and evaluate it across a comprehensive set of benchmarks, achieving performance comparable to other scientific language models of similar size, validating the quality and utility of SciLaD. We publish the dataset and evaluation pipeline to promote reproducibility, transparency, and further research in natural scientific language processing and understanding, including scholarly document processing.
